acceptance_predicates.description: The development catalog contains agentbench, agentdojo, agentops, ai-agents-that-matter, aider-polyglot, bigcodebench, core-bench, evalplus, exercism-tracks, hal, harbor, helm, inspect-ai, livecodebench, swe-bench, swe-bench-pro, swe-fficiency, swe-lancer, swe-mini, swe-perf, swe-rebench, tau-bench, and terminal-bench; subsequently documented external suites are admitted by the same schema.
Every documented catalog entry is development-installable, selectable, and bounded-executable; methodology-only, provenance-only, or production-authorization absence is not a development exclusion.
Every installable workload declares official primary source, immutable release/dataset identity, proof, license/terms, preparation closure, adapter, and compatibility.
Workloads are modeled as bundles/data through asb workload, never as executable asb tool records.
Adding a workload requires catalog identity/provenance/license/compatibility validation and cannot introduce arbitrary URLs or moving source state.

definition_of_done: Schema, catalog, fixtures, and workload-admission documentation pass.
Independent review and exact-head hosted checks pass.

outputs.description: Versioned official external workload acquisition/preparation catalog.

gates.description: External workload inventory, schema, primary-source, proof, and license rules validate.
Restricted, unsupported, unproven, incompatible, and arbitrary sources fail distinctly.
